name: oniesoft-test-platform
description: Drive the Oniesoft test platform from Claude Code: generate web/API/mobile test cases, run them (native mobile via Appium + self-healing semantic locators), and analyze failures.

platform_api_url.title: Platform API URL
platform_api_url.description: Base URL of the agentic_ai_be service (test-case generation & analysis).

execution_api_url.title: Execution API URL
execution_api_url.description: Base URL of the python_tool execution engine (runs test cases / test runs).

platform_api_key.title: API key
platform_api_key.description: Your personal Oniesoft API key. Generate one in the platform (Users > API Keys). Sent as the x-api-key header.

default_project_id.title: Default project ID
default_project_id.description: Project UUID used when a tool call doesn't specify one.

default_user_id.title: Default user ID
default_user_id.description: User UUID used when a tool call doesn't specify one (e.g. for runs).
